name: com.uni-tx.quests
description: Quests, missions and goals as entities: counter objectives reported from gameplay events, one-time/daily/weekly cadence with UTC resets, prerequisite chains, idempotent claims through com.uni-tx.rewards, and a backend seam for server authority.

samples.description: The whole lifecycle on a manual clock: reporting progress from game events, completing a prerequisite chain, claiming rewards, and watching a daily quest roll over at the reset hour.

A uGUI quest list: icon, name and description per quest, per-objective progress, a claim button that appears on completion, and locked/claimed overlays. Needs com.uni-tx.widgets and com.uni-tx.sprite-loader; without them the sample's assembly is skipped rather than breaking the project.
